story.title: ‘Scene’ OTT: Suriya’s crime thriller gets Rs 88 Cr digital deal
story.summary: Suriya's gripping Tamil crime thriller 'Scene' is set for its digital debut on December 4, following a successful box office run that raked in over Rs 211 crore globally since its premiere on November 6. The film's digital rights fetched an impressive Rs 88 crore, with a four-week theatrical viewing period before its streaming release.

story.title: Sharad Kapoor to make Hollywood debut in Jan amid viral appeal for work: 'Already got an offer'
story.summary: Sharad Kapoor explained that an injury from a football match has made it impossible for him to care for his four dogs. He left them at an animal shelter temporarily while he recovers, as advised by his doctor. Kapoor is planning to move to a larger home with adequate space for his pets. He clarified that a recent video seeking work was not a request for financial help from colleagues.
